items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Charles Hirsch was my grandfather. He was from Alsace-Lorraine.

ctx.x: And Charles Hirsch, where was he from?

Charles Hirsch was my grandfather. He was from Alsace-Lorraine. Now, one week, Alsace-Lorraine is Germany, and one next week, it's France. I never have been able to find out exactly where my grandfather, what city he was born from there. My cousin told me someplace where he was born, but I never did find out. I mean, I never knew.
Where did he come to in this country?
